blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Barren Island stands as the only active volcano present in India.
The Deccan Traps represent a vast basalt plateau region.
The formation of the Deccan Traps is attributed to large-scale fissure eruptions.
Direct question alert: Barren Island is frequently tested as India's sole active volcano.
Geological origin alert: Deccan Traps were formed by fissure eruptions resulting in a vast basalt plateau.

blocks.content: • Deccan Traps — vast basalt plateau formed by fissure eruptions.
